title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
description: 🪐 Discover our galaxy Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐 At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive. ✨ Key responsibilities As a Machine Learning Engineer Intern/ AI Engineer Intern you will collaborate with one engineering squad to design, develop, and deploy new features. Your work will involve: Development: Utilizing our modern tech stack, including Python, PyTorch, Catboost, BigQuery, Elasticsearch, Qdrant, and FastAPI. Optimization: Improving the performance, reliability, and security of existing services. Project Variety: Working on search algorithms, recommendation systems for freelancer matching, and skill taxonomy development. 🧑‍🚀 About you Education: Final-year engineering student (Master’s level or equivalent). Technical Foundations: Strong proficiency in at least one backend language (ideally Python) and a basic understanding of SQL. Core Engineering: Good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software design basics. Quality Focused: An interest in engineering excellence, including testing, clean code, and architecture. ML Knowledge: Ideally, some prior exposure to machine learning concepts. Communication: Proficiency in English, as it is our primary working language. Location: Ability to work from our Bordeaux office (132 Rue Fondaudège). 🚀 How to join the mission? First call with Pierre (Tech Lead Machine Learning Engineer) to discuss your experience, present the role in detail and answer your questions (45 mins) Optional small take home test (waived if you have a strong Open Source portfolio) Last round of 30 minutes with Sacha Vakili, Engineering Director Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫 - Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other onboardees at our office in Paris - Paid vacation - 1 paid day/month worked for interns, 5 weeks/year for apprenticeships - Lunch vouchers : €9/day on your Swile card - Transportation: 50% reimbursement (any type of transport) - Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow. - Remote work: Hybrid remote policy - Annual team building events Ready? Get your ticket to Malt 🪐 At Malt, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive. Your profile may be subject to background screening.
